title: @kirigami/plugin-embed options
description: Options for the `@kirigami/plugin-embed` entry under `plugins:` in kirigami.yaml.

style.description: Append the default `.embed` card styles to every sass task. Set false to write your own on top of the markup.

maxWidth.description: Caps how wide (and, via aspect-ratio, how tall) an `.embed` card can get — any CSS length, or "none" to remove the cap. Ignored when `style` is false (write your own `--embed-max-width` or width rule instead).

forcedAspectRatio.description: Pin every `.embed` card to one shape (e.g. "16 / 9", "1 / 1") instead of each video's own real aspect-ratio — handy for a uniform grid of cards. Empty (the default) uses each video's real ratio. Ignored when `style` is false.
